title: Section · Stats strip (KPI metrics row)
description: 4-cell KPI metrics row. Each cell: large display-typed number + mono label + short body. Cells separated by 1px hairlines (top + bottom + verticals between). One cell can be marked .is-accent to tint its number with the secondary CTA accent (typically the headline metric). Collapses to 2×2 at ≤880, 1-col at ≤480.

source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-24 — stats-strip adopted as canonical KPI/proof-point pattern

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

params.default: Field teams running daily ops on the platform across 7 verticals.
Operational throughput across the platform on a typical weekday.
Average across pilot cohort after 8 weeks on the platform — up from 71% pre-migration.
Configurable workflows scale from a 2-person crew to multi-region operations without a migration.

notes: Labels use the '// metric' mono pattern (matches the typographic hero variant). For more conventional labels, drop the leading '// '.
Cell 02 ships with .is-accent so the headline metric (jobs / day) reads as the platform's defining number. Move .is-accent to a different cell via CMS as needed.

Empty cells (.stat-num + .stat-label both empty) auto-hide via :has(). Grid columns won't reflow automatically though — for 3 visible cells the grid would leave a blank quarter. To get a clean 3-cell layout, change grid-template-columns at the section level.
